summary.headline: LAMEDITECH launches KRW 1.5bn rights offering, 1,002,004 new common shares at KRW 1,497
summary.what_happened: LAMEDITECH Co., Ltd. board resolved on Nov 26, 2026 to issue 1,002,004 new common shares through a general public rights offering, with a provisional issue price of KRW 1,497 per share (a 20% discount to the reference price). The offering is intended to raise funds mainly for operating capital, and the subscription period runs from Dec 1 to Dec 2, 2026, with new shares scheduled to list on Dec 17, 2026.
summary.why_it_matters: A rights offering of this type adds new shares to the company's existing share count, which can dilute the ownership percentage of existing shareholders who do not subscribe. Subscription pricing at a discount to the market reference price is a standard feature of this kind of offering, and the final issue price and share count may still change before the confirmed price is set.
